incident-bot: Paging: high error rate + latency cliff on inference-runtime (kv cache growth) for model=mistral-7b-mqa. Sev2. Alert triggered by latency_p95 > 1.5s and kv_cache_entries_total spike.
tilly (SRE): On it. I'm on-call. Affected region: us-west-2, routing to dedicated pool.
Raj Patel: Noted, I'm checking the runtime logs and batching metrics. Any recent deploys?
Amanda Chen: No user-facing deploys in the last hour. We did push a config tweak to continuous-batching defaults for new models ~30m ago (smaller max tokens).
David S.: Seeing a huge increase in kv cache size for the MQA variant: kv_cache_entries_total{model="mistral-7b-mqa"} jumped x15 in ~10m. p95 token latency spiked from 120ms -> 1.8s.
Mia K.: Customers: 3 high-traffic tenants on Dedicated; some internal smoke tests failing. Could be cache duplication when partial prompts get split into micro-batches.
tilly (SRE): Quick triage commands I'm running:
```sh
# cache entries for model
curl -s 'http://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=redwood_kv_cache_entries_total%7Bmodel%3D"mistral-7b-mqa"%7D' | jq .data.result
# open handles and memory
kubectl -n inference exec -it runtime-0 -- sh -c 'ps aux | grep runtime && cat /proc/meminfo | head -n 5'
```
# sample output (truncated):
metrics: [{"value": [1793456769, "152000"]}] -> 152k entries
runtime mem: RSS 82G (OOM risk on 96G nodes)

Raj Patel: I see correlation with continuous batching flush interval reduction; smaller flush interval + new tokenization for MQA variant seems to create redundant KV inserts. Continuous batching wasn't de-dup'ing prefixes properly for MQA.
Amanda Chen: On the model side, the MQA wrapper changed key normalization (token offsets) in the last sync. Could be the root cause.
David S.: Immediate mitigations proposed: 1) throttle requests to the model pool for Dedicated tenants 2) flip continuous-batching -> "per-request" for mistral-7b-mqa 3) evict KV cache old entries and reduce retention window.
tilly (SRE): I'm going to apply a targeted hotfix: disable continuous batching for model=mistral-7b-mqa and lower kv cache retention from 3600s -> 300s. Rolling patch to runtime config now.
```sh
# patch via configmap rollout
kubectl -n inference patch configmap runtime-config --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/models/mistral-7b-mqa/continuous_batching/enabled","value":false},{"op":"replace","path":"/models/mistral-7b-mqa/kv_cache/retention_seconds","value":300}]'
# annotate to trigger rollout
kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/runtime --field-manager=tilly-sre
```
incident-bot: deployment/runtime rollout started (uid: d4e9).
tilly (SRE): Patch applied. Watching metrics.
# 5m after changes
Raj Patel: kv_cache_entries_total dropping: 152k -> 18k. p95 latency improving: 1.8s -> 210ms.
Mia K.: Customers starting to recover. Internal canaries passing on primary routes.
Amanda Chen: We should also revert the tokenization normalization change in model wrapper until we have a de-dup test for continuous batching + MQA. I'll open a PR.
David S.: Logged a follow-up task: ENG-PLAT-1298 add prefix dedupe unit tests and a synthetic load test for MQA+continuous-batching.
tilly (SRE): Handoff plan: I'll stay on for 30m to validate stability, then hand to oncall-2 for the overnight window. oncall-2 please monitor kv_cache_entries_total, p95 latency, and memory RSS.
oncall-2: Ack. I'll take it after Tilly signs off.
Mia K.: Customer impact summary for ops report: ~3 Dedicated tenants saw 5-20% request failures and 2-4x latency increase for 25 minutes. No data exfiltration, no persistent token loss. Root cause suspected: batching config + MQA tokenization mismatch causing KV cache amplification.
tilly (SRE): Postmortem action items:
- Hotfix rollback plan (if needed) and stability window logged.
- ENG-ML to revert/patch tokenization normalization (Amanda)
- ENG-RUNTIME to add guardrails: per-model continuous-batching opt-out + cache de-dupe (Raj)
- Add synthetic load test in CI that exercises MQA variant under continuous-batching (David)
incident-bot: Incident updated to active -> mitigated.
tilly (SRE): Leaving notes in the incident board and will create the postmortem draft. Handoff complete to oncall-2. :white_check_mark: 
oncall-2: Taking over. I'll post a short status update every 30m until stable.
Amanda Chen: PR opened to revert normalization: https://git.internal/r/amanda/mqa-token-normalize/pull/12 (WIP)
David S.: Thanks all — good catch and fast triage. We'll follow up with a detailed postmortem and timeline.
incident-bot: Thread closed for now, will reopen if alerts re-fire.
